enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Lie still.

Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Walk to sink. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, and butter. Close refrigerator. Take out bread from cupboard. Pick up frying pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Put eggs on plate. Toast bread. Spread butter. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone for transport strike updates and rearranging the day to work from home
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open transport app. Read updates. Open email. Read work emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Dial phone. Call colleague. Speak: 'I will work from home today due to the strike.' Hang up. Open messaging app. Type message to team. Send message. Put down phone. Walk to bedroom. Set up computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home: telehealth consultations, patient records and administrative tasks on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Log in. Open telehealth software. Put on headset. Start video call. Speak with patient. Take notes. End call. Open patient records. Type notes. Save file. Open email. Reply to emails. Open administrative tasks. Fill out forms. Make phone calls. Schedule appointments. Turn off computer.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out salad ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Close cupboard. Put vegetables in bowl. Add dressing. Mix salad. Pick up fork. Eat lunch. Drink water. Pick up bowl. Rinse bowl. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home: continuing patient follow-ups, documentation and online meetings on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open patient follow-up list. Call patient. Speak: 'Hello, how are you feeling today?' Take notes. End call. Open documentation. Type reports. Save file. Open online meeting link. Join meeting. Speak: 'I agree with that plan.' Mute microphone. Listen. Unmute. Speak: 'Let's schedule next steps.' Leave meeting. Open email. Reply to messages. Turn off computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting laundry and running the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open laundry basket. Sort clothes into whites and colors. Pick up whites. Put whites into washing machine. Pick up colors. Put colors into washing machine. Close washing machine door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close drawer. Turn dial to set cycle. Press start button. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the living area
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under furniture. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Put vacuum away. Pick up items from floor. Place items in storage. Fluff pillows. Fold blanket. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out chicken and vegetables. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Pick up frying pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Put chicken in pan. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Put food on plate. Eat dinner. Drink water. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing: watching TV and browsing on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Browse internet. Check social media. Watch video. Put down computer. Continue watching TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow.
